news.title: Development, Validation and AI Chatbot Evaluation of the Adolescent Mental Health AI Response Tool
news.summary_en: The authors developed and validated a clinician-informed tool for auditing AI chatbot responses to adolescent mental health disclosures and used it to compare four major chatbots, finding better coverage of guideline-informed content for anxiety than depression and for moderate than severe presentations.

news.title: Enhancing Leadership Selection: Recommendations for a Multi-Factor, AI-Supported Assessment Tool for the Evaluation and Selection of U.S. Air Force Squadron Command Teams
news.summary_en: This report supports a comprehensive leadership assessment program for squadron command by identifying key competencies and derailing behaviors and by reviewing assessment methods that could improve the selection of effective squadron commanders.

news.title: Settlement and Governance Behind the AI Frontier
news.summary_en: Although there is much focus on cutting-edge AI models from frontier labs, the author argues that open-weight models, agents, and AI uses “behind the frontier” are also dangerous and their governance demands different concepts and tools.
